en.title: Jeju Private Car Hire: How to Tell a Legal Car from an Illegal One
en.desc: Licence plates, rental contracts and travel agencies: how Korean law treats paid rides in Jeju, what makes a hired car illegal, and what to check before you book.
en.h1: Is my Jeju private car legal? Plates, rentals and travel agencies explained
summary: Yellow plate with the Korean letter 바, 사, 아 or 자 = licensed commercial vehicle.
White plate with 하, 허 or 호 = rental car. It is only legal if you signed the rental contract and the rental company arranged the driver.
Any other white plate = private car. Carrying paying passengers in it is illegal, even if they say "the car is free, you only pay the guide".
A travel agency that rents a car in its own name and charges you for the ride is also breaking the law.
Illegal operators face up to 2 years in prison or a 20 million KRW fine; the bigger risk for you is that insurance may not cover you in an accident.

sections.body:
Korean plates show the vehicle's use in the Korean letter in the middle (for example 12하 3456).

  • Yellow plate, letter 바 / 사 / 아 / 자: a commercial passenger vehicle (taxi, licensed charter). These are allowed to carry paying passengers.
  • White plate, letter 하 / 허 / 호: a rental car. Whether the ride is legal depends on who rented it — see step 2.
  • White plate, any other letter: a private car. Paid passenger transport in a private car is banned (Passenger Transport Service Act, Art. 81).

Ask the operator for the plate number before the trip, and check it again when the car arrives.

sections.h: Step 2: rental car with a driver — when is it legal?
sections.body:
Korean law does not let rental cars be used to carry paying passengers, and normally bans rental companies from supplying drivers (Art. 34). There is an exception: a rental company may arrange a driver for certain renters, and foreign visitors are one of them. Separate rules allow drivers for 11 to 15-seat vans rented for tourism (6 hours or more, or to and from an airport or port).

So a legal set-up looks like this:

  • The rental contract is in your name (or your group's), signed with a licensed rental company.
  • The driver is arranged by that rental company.

It is illegal when the operator or driver rents the car in their own name and then charges you for the ride, or when a rental company carries paying passengers itself.

sections.h: Step 3: booking through a travel agency
sections.body:
Many Jeju charters are sold by travel agencies on Xiaohongshu or WeChat. The agency itself must be a registered travel business (Tourism Promotion Act). Then check the car:

  • Agency rents a car in its own name, adds a driver and charges you: illegal.
  • Agency uses a private car: illegal — including the common line "the car is free, you only pay for the guide".
  • Legal options: a yellow-plate licensed vehicle, or a rental contract in your own name with the driver arranged by the rental company.

If the agency can't show you which of these it is, treat it as a risk.

• Insurance: ordinary private or rental car insurance may not cover paid passenger transport. In an accident, you could be left without compensation.
  • Trips cut short: Jeju police and city officials run joint checks at tourist spots. If the car is stopped, your day can end there.
  • Penalties for operators: illegal paid transport can bring up to 2 years in prison or a 20 million KRW fine, and running an unregistered travel business up to 3 years or 30 million KRW (as reported by Korean media).

In May 2026 Jeju police reported a group that recruited tourists on Chinese social media and drove them in ordinary rental cars, charging 20,000–30,000 KRW per person.

1. Plate: yellow 바/사/아/자, or white 하/허/호 with a contract in your name.
  2. Paperwork: business registration or travel agency registration.
  3. Insurance: ask whether it covers paid passenger transport.
  4. Price: base hours, overtime, fuel, tolls, parking, driver's meals.
  5. Cancellation: get it in writing and keep the chat.

For current price ranges, see Jeju private car prices 2026.

faq.q: What does the letter 허 on a white plate mean?
faq.a: 하, 허 and 호 are used for rental cars. The ride is only legal if the rental contract is in your name and the rental company arranged the driver.

faq.q: The agency says the car is free and I only pay for the guide. Is that legal?
faq.a: No. Calling the payment a guide fee does not change it: carrying paying customers in a private car, or in a car the agency rented in its own name, is illegal.
Yes. Taxis carry yellow commercial plates and are licensed to carry paying passengers, including hourly or day hire.

faq.q: Can a rental company provide a driver for foreigners?
faq.a: Yes. Foreign visitors are one of the cases where Korean law lets a rental company arrange a driver for the renter. The contract should be in your name.

faq.q: Will I be fined for riding in an illegal car?
faq.a: The penalties described here are aimed at the operators. The main risk for passengers is having no insurance cover if something goes wrong.

zh.title: 济州包车怎么分辨合法车和黑车？看车牌、租车合同和旅行社
zh.desc: 车牌颜色和字母、租车合同、旅行社资质：韩国法律如何规定济州收费载客，哪些包车属于违法，下单前要确认什么。
zh.h1: 济州包车合法吗？车牌、租车和旅行社一次讲清楚
summary: 黄色车牌，中间韩文是「바、사、아、자」＝ 营运车辆，可以合法收费载客。
白色车牌，韩文是「하、허、호」＝ 租赁车。只有以您本人名义签租车合同、司机由租车公司安排，才合法。
其他白色车牌＝ 私家车。收费载客违法，即使对方说「车费免费，只收导游费」。
旅行社以自己名义租车、再向您收车费，同样违法。
经营者最高可处2年有期徒刑或2,000万韩元罚款；对您来说更大的风险是出事故时保险可能不赔。

sections.body:
韩国车牌中间的韩文字母表示车辆用途（例如 12하 3456）。

  • 黄色车牌，字母 바 / 사 / 아 / 자：营运客车（出租车、正规包车公司）。可以合法收费载客。
  • 白色车牌，字母 하 / 허 / 호：租赁车。是否合法取决于是谁租的车——见第二步。
  • 白色车牌，其他字母：私家车。私家车收费载客被法律禁止（《旅客汽车运输事业法》第81条）。

出发前向商家要车牌号，车到了再核对一次。

sections.h: 第二步：租赁车带司机，什么情况下合法？
sections.body:
韩国法律禁止用租赁车收费载客，原则上也禁止租车公司给租车人安排司机（第34条）。但有例外：租车公司可以为特定租车人安排司机，外国游客就是其中之一。另外，以旅游为目的租用11–15座商务车（6小时以上，或往返机场、港口）也可以配司机。

所以合法的做法是：

  • 租车合同以您本人（或同行人）名义与正规租车公司签订；
  • 司机由该租车公司安排。

如果是商家或司机以自己名义租车、再向您收车费，或者租车公司自己拿租赁车载客收费，都属于违法。

sections.h: 第三步：通过旅行社订车
sections.body:
济州很多包车是旅行社在小红书、微信上卖的。旅行社本身必须是依法登记的旅行社（《观光振兴法》）。然后再看车：

  • 旅行社以自己名义租车、派司机、向您收费：违法。
  • 旅行社用私家车载客：违法——包括常见的「车费免费，只收导游费」。
  • 合法的方式：黄色车牌营运车辆；或租车合同以您本人名义签订、司机由租车公司安排。

如果旅行社说不清是哪一种，就当作有风险。

• 保险：普通私家车或租赁车保险可能不涵盖收费载客。一旦出事故，您可能得不到赔偿。
  • 行程中断：济州警察和市政府会在景点联合检查，车被拦下，当天行程可能就结束了。
  • 经营者的处罚：非法收费载客最高可处2年有期徒刑或2,000万韩元罚款；无登记经营旅行社最高3年或3,000万韩元（据韩国媒体报道）。

2026年5月，济州自治警察通报了一个团伙：在中国社交平台招揽游客，用普通租赁车载客，每人收2万–3万韩元。

1. 车牌：黄色 바/사/아/자，或白色 하/허/호 且合同以您本人名义。
  2. 资质：营业执照或旅行社登记证。
  3. 保险：问清是否涵盖收费载客。
  4. 费用：基础时长、超时费、油费、过路费、停车费、司机餐费。
  5. 取消规则：写在聊天里并保留记录。

价格行情见济州包车多少钱（2026）。

faq.q: 白色车牌上的「허」是什么意思？
faq.a: 하、허、호 是租赁车专用字母。只有租车合同以您本人名义、司机由租车公司安排时才合法。

faq.q: 旅行社说车免费，只收导游费，这样合法吗？
faq.a: 不合法。把费用叫作导游费并不能改变性质：用私家车或旅行社自己名义租的车载客收费，都属于违法。

faq.q: 观光出租车包车合法吗？
faq.a: 合法。出租车是黄色营运车牌，可以合法收费载客，包括按小时或按天包车。

faq.q: 租车公司可以给外国人配司机吗？
faq.a: 可以。韩国法律规定外国游客属于租车公司可以安排司机的情形之一，但租车合同应以您本人名义签订。

faq.q: 坐了黑车，乘客会被罚款吗？
faq.a: 这里提到的处罚针对经营者。对乘客来说，主要风险是出事时没有保险保障。
